ambiguities.statement: The authoritative inventory originally exposed its exact count only as authoritative_population_count, while the handoff validator uses the established feature_count or population_count aliases.
ambiguities.preservation: The existing value 9 was not changed. A root feature_count: 9 metadata alias was added, matching authoritative_population_count, the nine-entry feature list, and summary.selected_features. No feature, status, source, proof state, unresolved item, blocker, or scientific semantic changed.

ambiguities.statement: Finalized artifacts preserve historical line-range anchors that do not always coincide exactly with the current rendered line positions in maths/06-theorems/theorems.md, although the cited semantic sections and statements remain identifiable.
ambiguities.preservation: Traceability preserves the authoritative ranges from the feature artifacts rather than silently rewriting provenance.

ambiguities.statement: Algorithm artifacts list total ordered steps and test plans refer to the first violated precondition, but the scientific contracts do not establish the full internal order as observable behavior.
ambiguities.preservation: Packages require all validation and preservation obligations before success and preserve stable condition-to-error mappings without prescribing a total internal algorithm. Feature 008 alone preserves source order as an output postcondition.

ambiguities.statement: Exact covered populations are required, but the artifacts do not assign a distinct stable error code to every otherwise complete input containing an uncovered object or omitting a covered object while satisfying other local fields.
ambiguities.preservation: Successful output is forbidden for a population mismatch. No new code was invented; transport-level rejection for an unmapped edge condition remains implementation-defined until an authoritative code is assigned.

ambiguities.statement: The authoritative artifacts require per-dimension removal claims but do not finalize the DimensionId universe, cardinality, or ordering beyond source provenance and claim-family separation.
ambiguities.preservation: The mapping is constrained to be nonempty, sourced, opaque, and separate from the transformation family; concrete dimension representation and order remain implementation-defined.

ambiguities.statement: Community stability semantics, cross-domain dimension classifications, and rational coherence are unresolved and have no executable scientific definitions in the domain artifacts.
ambiguities.preservation: All exact unresolved identifiers remain attached as preserved_unresolved. Structural operations remain executable; scientific evaluation remains unsupported.

ambiguities.statement: The v1.0 domain-catalog schema requests no hash field and forbids additional properties, while the task requests calculable hashes.
ambiguities.preservation: No out-of-schema field was added. Repository-relative package paths and Git objects allow hashes to be calculated externally.
